subject: Zephyr renewal: benchmark sprint & capacity uplift ask
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyr.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@zephyr.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — need a short benchmark sprint + capacity quote

Hi Soojin,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're starting contract renewal planning and an incumbent vendor just put a hard capacity/price offer on the table for our inference layer. Before we make any moves we'd like to run a short, scoped benchmark against our production-ish prompt set to validate Redwood's latency/cost claims and confirm an uplift path for peak hours.

Ask: can Redwood run a 48-hour "proof sprint" next week that includes:
- a throughput run targeting 50 requests/s sustained for 6-hour windows
- latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for both token and full-response
- token cost estimate based on our prompt mix

If possible, we also need a provisional capacity uplift offer (monthly commitment + burst) and a short list of what you'd need from our side (sample prompts, credentials, network allowlist). We're on a compressed timeline — renewal committee meets 04/05.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform, Zephyr Analytics

Attachments: zephyr_inference_profile.csv (attachment stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyr.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — need a short benchmark sprint + capacity quote

Thanks Alicia — we can run this. High level plan and items we need below.

Plan (48-hour proof sprint):
- Day 0: ingest sample prompts + align test harness (we'll use our continuous-batching harness).
- Day 1: run throughput windows and collect p50/p95/p99 across both short/long prompts.
- Day 2: replay edge cases + validate KV cache hit behavior and tail latencies.

What we need from you:
- representative prompt set (CSV) + peak hour schedule
- a sandbox API key or a temporary allowlist for a dedicated test enclave
- success criteria (latency/cost thresholds you need to beat)

Commercial outline:
- Provisional uplift quote: 3x standard throughput capacity pool for 30 days (we'll provide numbers after we baseline)
- If results meet thresholds, we'll include a 10% term credit and 60-day rate lock for renewal commitments signed by 04/12.

Ben, can you attach the test harness + a short runbook for Zephyr? Marissa, can you draft a short conditional term addendum we can push if the sprint validates the uplift? Karthik, flag any infra gotchas.

Sooj in
Soojin Lee
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: zephyr_benchmark_plan.xlsx (placeholder)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — need a short benchmark sprint + capacity quote

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 10:02 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Plan (48-hour proof sprint):
> - Day 0: ingest sample prompts + align test harness (we'll use our continuous-batching harness).

Attached is the harness (test_harness_v4.zip stub) and a short runbook. Key technical notes:
- We'll spin a dedicated proof pool in your region (us-west-2) — no shared capacity mixing.
- We need an allowlist IP range and a temporary API key; if you prefer we can provision a VPC endpoint for the test.
- For fairness, we'll replay your production prompt mix at scaled concurrency; please include the prompt length distribution.

Preliminary metrics we'll report: p50/p95/p99 latency per model variant, tokens/sec, avg tokens per response, cache hit rate, and projected per-token cost under your monthly profile.

I'll attach a small JMeter config you can run from your side if you want parallel verification.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: test_harness_v4.zip (attachment stub); runbook_proof_sprint.md (attachment stub)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyr.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@zephyr.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — need a short benchmark sprint + capacity quote

Thanks — this looks good. We're OK with a dedicated proof pool in us-west-2. We'll provide:
- prompt_set_v3.csv (attached)
- allowlist: 18.42.120.0/24 and 18.42.121.0/24 (temporary)
- success criteria doc: target p95 < 420ms for short prompts, projected token cost within 15% of current vendor

We can start Day 0 on 03/29. One ask: the incumbent vendor is offering an aggressive one-year committed price if we sign by 04/05. If Redwood can provide a signed conditional addendum that (a) guarantees the uplift capacity at the quoted rate for 60 days post-sprint and (b) includes a rollback path if the sprint fails to meet the criteria, that'll help our procurement team.

Alicia

Attachment: prompt_set_v3.csv (attachment stub); zephyr_success_criteria.docx (attachment stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — need a short benchmark sprint + capacity quote

Alicia — thanks for the prompt set and criteria. Quick internal notes and next steps: 
- Ben: schedule proof pool on 03/29 and confirm monitoring hooks for p99 alerts.
- Marissa: drafting the conditional addendum — plan is: provisional uplift commitment (30d term) + 60d rate lock if sprint passes; else automatic conversion to a month-to-month with priority support for 30 days. I'll share redlines by EOD 03/26.
- Karthik: check if the VPC endpoint adds any latency artifacts; if yes, we'll keep to the allowlist route.

Commercial: I'm approving the 10% term credit as proposed and a limited one-time make-good if p95 exceeds targets in week 1. We should avoid an open multi-year discount before the sprint. If the sprint validates, I'll ask RevOps to prepare a 12-month reserved capacity SKU with the agreed uplift price.

Alicia — can you confirm procurement calendar and whether DocuSign route is acceptable for the conditional addendum? If yes we'll prepare the DocuSign template for signature 03/30 (conditional on results).

Thanks — Soojin

--
Sooj in Lee
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: contract_redlines_0317.docx (placeholder)
